		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = BALTIC_rebuild_forts } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							OR = {
								has_focus_tree = estonia_tree
								has_focus_tree = latvia_tree
								has_focus_tree = lithuania_tree
							}
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = BALTIC_rebuild_forts }
							AND = {

		OR = {
			AND = {
				original_tag = LIT
				controls_state = 11
			}
			AND = {
				original_tag = LAT
				controls_state = 12
			}
			AND = {
				original_tag = EST
				controls_state = 13
			}
		}
	
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = BALTIC_rebuild_forts uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = BALTIC_rebuild_forts
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = CHI_guidance_and_support } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							OR = {
								has_focus_tree = china_communist_focus
								has_focus_tree = china_nationalist_focus
								has_focus_tree = manchukuo_focus
							}
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = CHI_guidance_and_support }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = CHI_guidance_and_support uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = CHI_guidance_and_support
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = CHI_militarize } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = china_nationalist_sea_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = CHI_militarize }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = CHI_militarize uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = CHI_militarize
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = FIN_political_unity } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = finnish_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = FIN_political_unity }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = FIN_political_unity uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = FIN_political_unity
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = GER_rocketry_innovations } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = german_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_rocketry_innovations }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = GER_rocketry_innovations uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = GER_rocketry_innovations
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}

		icon = generic_research
		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = HABSBURG_mechanized_initiative } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							OR = {
								has_focus_tree = austria_focus_tree
								has_focus_tree = austro_hungarian_releasable_focus
								has_focus_tree = czech_focus
								has_focus_tree = mu_czech_focus
								has_focus_tree = wuw_hungarian_focus
							}
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = HABSBURG_mechanized_initiative }
							AND = {

		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = HABSBURG_is_subject_puppeteer_faction_leader_or_member_trigger_tt
			OR = {
				# FOR DANUBIAN FEDERATION
				AND = {
					is_faction_leader = yes
					any_allied_country = {
						HABSBURG_is_a_habsburg_viable_nation = yes 
					}	
				}
				AND = {
					is_faction_leader = no
					OR = {
						AND = {
							is_in_faction_with = HUN
							HUN = {
								is_faction_leader = yes
							}
						}
						AND = {
							is_in_faction_with = AUS
							AUS = {
								is_faction_leader = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				# FOR AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN PUPPET PATHS
				AND = {
					OR = {
						original_tag = HUN
						original_tag = AUS
					}
					any_subject_country = {
						HABSBURG_is_a_habsburg_viable_nation = yes
					}
					is_subject = no
				}
				AND = {
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = HUN
						is_subject_of = AUS
					}
				}
			}
			HABSBURG_is_a_habsburg_viable_nation = yes 
		}
	
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = HABSBURG_mechanized_initiative uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = HABSBURG_mechanized_initiative
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = PRC_raiding_parties } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = china_communist_focus_sea
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = PRC_raiding_parties }
							AND = {

			has_war = yes
		
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = PRC_raiding_parties uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = PRC_raiding_parties
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = RAJ_royal_indian_navy } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = indian_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = RAJ_royal_indian_navy }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = RAJ_royal_indian_navy uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = RAJ_royal_indian_navy
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}

		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc
					event_target:ht_focus_state = { OWNER = { has_completed_focus = SIA_a_modern_economy } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = ht_focus_com
					event_target:ht_focus_state = {
						OWNER = {
							has_focus_tree = siam_focus
							NOT = { has_completed_focus = SIA_a_modern_economy }
							AND = {

			num_of_factories > 50
		
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = {
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_focus_unc } }
						uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = SIA_a_modern_economy uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = yes }
					}
					else = {
						complete_national_focus = SIA_a_modern_economy
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = ht_note_fp_a
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ht_notify_cd } } set_country_flag = { flag = ht_notify_cd days = 1 } news_event = { id = hosttool.73 } }
			}
		}
	}
